criteria.title: Question & dataset fit
criteria.description: A real engineering question is stated, and the chosen dataset can actually answer it. Provenance and licence stated.

criteria.title: Data quality work
criteria.description: Defects found and handled with written justification. A data quality statement is present.

criteria.title: Analysis & visualisation
criteria.description: Four or more charts, each answering a stated question. Correct chart types, labelled axes, findings in the captions.

criteria.title: Findings & interpretation
criteria.description: Conclusions supported by the analysis, stated in engineering terms, with limitations acknowledged.

criteria.title: Individual contribution log
criteria.description: Present, specific, and consistent with the repository's commit history.
